result.description: Sales CRM for SMBs with built-in calling, email, SMS, pipelines and automation.
result.auth_detail: API key sent via HTTP Basic (key as username, empty password), created per user in Settings → Developer → API Keys. OAuth2 auth-code flow with Bearer tokens; app created self-serve in Settings → Developer → OAuth Apps; refresh via offline_access.
result.access_detail: Gate audit: (1) OAuth apps private by default (own org only); public use by other orgs needs vendor review, but each end user can self-create an API key, which is not a gate. (2) No free plan; 14-day no-card trial. High-volume API access not included on Solo plan, included on Essentials+. REST API stated as available; trial API access not explicitly confirmed. Developer needs trial or paid account; no separate sandbox found.
result.api_notes: REST API covering leads, contacts, opportunities, activities (calls/email/SMS), custom fields, smart views, sequences, webhooks etc. Endpoint-specific rate limits, no daily quota or per-request fees.
result.blocker: No free plan (14-day trial only); public OAuth app for other orgs requires Close review; per-user API keys avoid this. Solo plan lacks high-volume API access.
